CustomGeometry.Source: ui/lab.js addLabShape; exact evaluated native JS at zero pan

LegacyGeometryElements.PolygonPlacement: scale width/100, height/100 then translate X,Y

DesignSemantics.ClosedCubic: P[i], P[i].Out or P[i], P[i+1].In or P[i+1], P[i+1]; wrap only when Closed
DesignSemantics.OpenStroke: Widen with round caps and joins, Thickness, flatness .025
DesignSemantics.Booleans: Clipper2 EvenOdd at precision 4; per-channel path order; clip at canvas bounds
DesignSemantics.Hotspot: must be finite and >=0,<100; actual eligible shape anchor required by native Lab
DesignSemantics.GeneratedIds: Native runtime-generated UUIDs; regenerate for independent user copies

Animation.NativeAvailability: Orbit/Float/Blink require decorative paths, except Blink allowed on Wait and No

Request.project: optional complete StudioProject; parsed/validated for all except catalog

Envelope.Transport: native window.chrome.webview postMessage and PostWebMessageAsJson; native https://cursorstudio.local only; browser port must use local adapter
Envelope.Note: PascalCase native project/design/catalog properties; lowercase envelope keys

labOpen.behavior: existing editable design, captured effective built-in role, or blank; custom hotspot applied after default stored

labTemplate.behavior: clear custom family; reset selected RoleSettings; Generate theme; Capture scene; Validate design

labSave.behavior: validate safety; create/update custom family; seed other roles from existing editable designs or native captured templates; clear custom hotspot only on edited role

labCheck.behavior: null means pass native save-safety checks

labPreviewFrames.behavior: 160px frames; native anchor count; checks fixed hotspot

preview.behavior: size clamped 16..256; native frame-count modulo; hotspot is lower-case x,y pixel coordinates

previewFrames.behavior: max 12 frames per batch; count is native anchor count

previewFamily.behavior: 96px selected family/role with custom designs cleared

previewSkin.behavior: 64px Arrow; own preset tint, RGB disabled, transparency zero

DemoPolicy.Exports: no export controls or export handlers of any kind
DemoPolicy.DesktopEffects: demo canvas visual behavior only; never desktop APIs
DemoPolicy.Persistence: browser-local demo storage only; never native owner AppData, cursor registry, receipts or Windows state

StaticCatalogScope.Included: 14 built-in families, 17 roles each, 44 preset skins, native blank/default project/design semantics and 39 editable shape recipes
StaticCatalogScope.Excluded: owner custom families/skins/projects/drafts/workspaces/windows status/receipts; intentionally not read

ExactSceneEncoding.Coordinates: 0..100 normalized native System.Drawing float values, explicitly projected X,Y
ExactSceneEncoding.PathType: type&7: 0 Start, 1 Line, 3 cubic Bezier point; type&128 closes contour. Bezier points appear in triples (control1,control2,end).
ExactSceneEncoding.Masks: CoreEngine fills each original GraphicsPath in white separately, in native layer order, into each channel mask. Preserve each path fill mode and layer identity.
ExactSceneEncoding.EditableAlternative: Templates are exact DesignEngine.Capture(scene), validated; ordered shape operations and holes are retained. Each template UUID is a native-generated capture identity, not a stable built-in identity.

FamilyGeometryGenerator.BuiltIn: ThemeRoleGeometry.Create(resolved family ID, role); FamilyShapes.Pointer called with width=1,length=1
FamilyGeometryGenerator.StoredGeometrySettings: Geometry.Language/Width/Length/Roundness/Complexity/Mirror are serialized/validated and cache-keyed, but not consumed by current FamilyGeometryGenerator or ThemeRoleGeometry; do not invent shape deformation.
FamilyGeometryGenerator.StoredSeed: Seed is serialized/cache-keyed, but not consumed by current theme geometry.
FamilyGeometryGenerator.RoleDesign: FamilyGeometryGenerator.Generate returns DesignEngine.Generate immediately when Role.Design exists; in this branch role scale/rotation/offset/elements are not applied. It applies CustomHotspot there, but VectorCursorRenderer directly calls DesignEngine.Generate for Role.Design and bypasses this generator override. Browser renderer should follow Rendering.cs.
FamilyGeometryGenerator.CustomFamilyMissingRole: CustomFamilyId != null and Role.Design null returns an empty GeometryScene before custom base/elements/transforms.
FamilyGeometryGenerator.UseCustomBase: Start with empty scene instead of native role; set initial scene hotspot to role HotspotX/HotspotY; append GeometryElement paths; then apply role transform.
FamilyGeometryGenerator.Elements: Types and placement are in CustomGeometry.LegacyGeometryElements; all added after built-in layers. Channels Detail/Motion honored, else Body.
FamilyGeometryGenerator.RoleTransform: Apply around center: q = R(Rotation) * ((p - [50,50]) * Scale/100) + [50+OffsetX,50+OffsetY]. Apply to all layer points including Bezier handles and native hotspot. GDI Matrix uses native screen-coordinate rotation.
FamilyGeometryGenerator.CustomHotspot: For built-in/custom-base generator: if CustomHotspot true, effective scene Hotspot is role HotspotX/Y without transform; else transformed initial scene hotspot.
FamilyGeometryGenerator.RoleEnabled: Does not suppress Generate or direct Render; enabled-role filtering belongs to native production/apply, which website demo does not invoke.
FamilyGeometryGenerator.GlobalEffects: Project.Effects does not change cursor geometry/surface pipeline; native desktop companion uses it separately. Demo effects must remain canvas-only.

NativeRenderingGeometry.RoleMotion: If Channel==Motion and role is Wait/AppStarting, rotate each motion layer by 360*CursorAnimation.MotionPhase(project,phase).
NativeRenderingGeometry.SkinPhase: reverse design animation uses 1-phase for skin/color phase
NativeRenderingGeometry.GeometryOpacity: Color.Transparency final alpha (or fallback 100-Skin.Opacity); geometry is retained
NativeRenderingGeometry.AnimationGeometry: DesignEngine.Generate handles Rotate/Pulse/Orbit/Float/Blink; Shimmer changes lighting; Spin Axis handled by AxisSpinEngine during rendering.

EffectChoices.KeepRunningInBackground: native serialized default true; website must never create background desktop effects

NativeSafety.FloatOrbit: must target decorative paths away from hotspot
NativeSafety.Blink: whole cursor allowed only for Wait/No, otherwise selected decorations
NativeSafety.FrameChecks: visible pixels alpha>12; clickable-role contact alpha>48 within radius=max(3,ceil(size*.16)); hotspot fixed between frames
